prompt: Create a high fidelity desktop web application UI design mockup for Ilimmu, a private Genshin Impact companion. Landscape 1536x1024. Actual flat screen, no device frame. Operate mode, clean quiet beautiful compact app like GGArtifact. Deep charcoal navy #10131D canvas, #1B2130 panels, soft warm gold #E3BD73 restrained accents, off-white text, muted slate labels, precise Manrope-like sans UI, elegant understated character headings. Use recognizable full-color Genshin character portraits and weapon/artifact game icons as data thumbnails only, no decorative background art. Left 180px app navigation with Ilimmu name, Characters active, Profile, Weapons, Inventory, Goals, Conflicts, Export. Main heading Characters, subtitle 'Your roster. Your builds.' Search characters, filter Owned / All, element filter, sort Name. No add character button. Each character has an accessible Owned toggle and profile link. One build per character with weapon picker, artifact set picker, Sands / Goblet / Circlet main stat selectors. NO substats, NO weights or 100 numbers, NO DPS/Support selectors, NO on-field/off-field selectors, NO Add Build. Synthetic example content: Furina Hydro Sword Fontaine 5-star owned, level 80; Neuvillette Hydro Catalyst Fontaine 5-star owned level 90; Kaedehara Kazuha Anemo Sword Inazuma 5-star owned level 90; Nahida Dendro Catalyst Sumeru 5-star not owned. Furina weapon Fleuve Cendre Ferryman, artifact Golden Troupe, Sands HP%, Goblet Hydro DMG Bonus, Circlet CRIT Rate. Neuvillette weapon Prototype Amber, artifact Marechaussee Hunter, Sands HP%, Goblet Hydro DMG Bonus, Circlet CRIT DMG. Kazuha Iron Sting, Viridescent Venerer, Elemental Mastery all three slots. Beautiful spacing and readable real labels, low chrome, no metric dashboard. OPTION B: dense single-page roster table, six characters visible. Character identity and portrait in first wide column, ownership tick beside name, Weapon and Artifact as compact thumbnail-name columns, and three clear labeled main-stat dropdown columns. Main stat column headings in table header. Character rows approximately 125px tall, no nesting of cards. Sticky-looking toolbar has search, Owned/All segmented filter, compact named element chips. Elegant separators, flat quiet navy surface. At bottom show Amber Pyro Bow Mondstadt 4-star unowned, and Fischl Electro Bow Mondstadt owned. Excellent typography and readable controls. Clearly title this screen Characters, no option labels painted.
